what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In-person at Town Hall; the meeting will not be suspended if the virtual broadcast fails. Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=83813796157, Meeting ID: 909 174 0347, Join by Phone: (888) 475-4499

items.agenda_line: Earth Removal Application Renewal for 780 Northfield Road by Jim Lattanzi
items.why_it_matters: The board is scheduled to take up renewal of a permit allowing earth removal at this property.

items.agenda_line: Introduction of Jessica “Jak” Miller, Assistant Town Manager
items.why_it_matters: A new town staff position is being introduced to the board and public.

items.agenda_line: Acknowledgment of the Resignation of Denise McCue, Data Collector for the Assessor’s Office effective September 10, 2026
items.why_it_matters: A town office position has become vacant.

items.agenda_line: Refer Articles Submitted by the Planning Board and Director of Planning and Economic Development to the Planning Board
items.why_it_matters: This sets which body will review articles headed to the November Special Town Meeting warrant.

items.agenda_line: Report to Town Meeting Under Article 1: Reports to Town Meeting- Regarding Article 10 of the November 2024 Special Town Meeting “Request to Select Board Re: The Brooks House”
items.why_it_matters: The board is due to report back on the future of the Brooks House, a town-owned building, per a prior Town Meeting request.

items.agenda_line: Donation of Boulder to be Located in Front of Town Hall
items.why_it_matters: A physical addition to Town Hall grounds, funded and installed entirely by private donors, is being presented to the board.

items.agenda_line: Discussion of Opioid Settlement Funds: Use for AEDs in All Town/School Buildings and Police/Fire Vehicles
items.why_it_matters: The board may discuss directing opioid-settlement money toward defibrillators in town and school buildings and emergency vehicles.
A town policy governing how appointments are made is being revised.

items.agenda_line: Introduce Boards, Committees, and Commissions Handbook and Next Steps
items.why_it_matters: A new governance handbook for town boards and committees is being introduced.
The board may discuss the condition or use of town-owned buildings.
The board may discuss a food pantry that serves residents.

preview.hook: Opioid-settlement money for AEDs, a Brooks House report, and municipal buildings
preview.one_line: Select Board, Tue 9/15 7pm: opioid-settlement funds for AEDs, a Brooks House report, municipal buildings, and an appointment-policy edit.
